## Critique
- claim-1: Artifact `b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f` supplies the previously missing degreewise data \(M_d,U_d,V_d,D_d\) for every \(9\le d\le25\), including the boundary witness \(M_9=D_9=0_{0\times1}\), \(U_9=I_0\), \(V_9=[1]\). It records \(U_dM_dV_d=D_d\), \(|\det U_d|=|\det V_d|=1\), and positive divisibility-ordered Smith diagonals. The resulting quotient free ranks are
  \[
  (1,1,2,2,2,1,1,0,\ldots,0),
  \]
  and every torsion list is empty. Thus the computation evidence repairs the witness deficiency identified at `artifacts/internal-sources/c6788a6dbd775caa781a4a9b2da1fb42cec6e3479c7760f5022a994ee0cf7513/artifact.txt@L17-L27`. However, the specialist narrative does not explicitly distinguish the failed source attempt from the repaired result or state outright whether the bounded target is now established, as required.
- claim-2: Correct. The finite computation establishes only this specified case and no parent or all-parameter theorem.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] Add a standalone linkage-and-status certificate: define
  \[
  C_d=\{\mu:333\subseteq\mu\subseteq5^5,\ |\mu|=d\},
  \quad
  R_d=\{(t,\lambda):1\le t\le5,\ 333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5,\ |\lambda|=d-t\},
  \]
  and
  \[
  (M_d)_{(t,\lambda),\mu}
  =\mathbf1_{\{\mu/\lambda\text{ is a horizontal }t\text{-strip}\}}.
  \]
  Prove explicitly that
  \[
  (A_+J)_d=\operatorname{rowspan}_{\mathbb Z}(M_d),
  \qquad
  (J/A_+J)_d\cong\mathbb Z^{C_d}/\operatorname{rowspan}_{\mathbb Z}(M_d),
  \]
  using \(A_+=(h_1,\ldots,h_5)\). Then state that artifact `40031afbf3b96db8def7ba58fe3647a0fde45c45399e638c5e098bfe53103a40` did **not** establish the requested target because it lacked \(UMV=D\) witnesses and was only an adjacent partial result, whereas artifact `b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f` supplies those witnesses and therefore establishes this bounded certificate only.

## Required revisions
- Add the explicit matrix-to-\(A_+J\) equality and quotient definition.
- Explicitly state both the failure status of the source attempt and the established status of the repaired bounded certificate.
- Do not infer any parent theorem.
